# geom_from_dets fixtures

Frozen Copisteria 28m detection JSON used by `preview/test_geom_systems.py`.
Images live in `eval/reference/`. These files are detections only, not weights.

- `c_major_simple.dets_v7_768.json` — piano grand staff, 4 measures.
- `xiaoxingxing_treble.dets_v7_1376.json` — 10 single-staff systems, 12 measures
  (systems 2 and 8 contain two bars). Source image license: see
  `eval/reference/SOURCES.md`.
